title: Application for tax break for MHANY housing rehab, Bronx
summary: This application would approve a real property tax exemption for a cluster of buildings at four Bronx sites being rehabilitated by a housing development fund company under the MHANY Cluster 2 program. The exemption, authorized under Section 577 of the Private Housing Finance Law, would run for up to seven years from an effective date of February 4, 2020, and could end early if the property is not operated under its regulatory agreement. It applies to land and existing buildings but not to future construction.
